## Standard acceptance criteria (apply to every issue)

- Unit tests cover the new logic and edge cases.
- Docs updated (user, admin, or developer as appropriate).
- CI green on macOS arm64/x64, Windows x64, and Linux x64.
- No screen content or raw text appears in logs, dumps, or crash reports.

## Epic detail

### E01 — Foundations & Governance

Repo, CI, licensing, advisory panel, ethics, fixture dataset, benchmark harness, threat model.

**Goals**

- A clean-checkout build and test run on macOS, Windows, and Linux.
- A paid advisory panel with cognitive and learning disabilities.
- A licensed fixture dataset and a benchmark that produces a baseline report.
- A threat model and data inventory reviewed by an external security reviewer.

**Exit criteria:** CI green on 5 targets; panel contracted; bench produces a report; threat model reviewed.

### E02 — Platform Core & App Shell

Tauri shell, event bus, config, local store, overlay window, shortcuts, panic key, settings UI, CLI.

**Goals**

- Capture a window, show a transparent overlay, toggle it, panic-hide it.
- Persist profiles in an encrypted store.
- A new contributor can build and run in under 15 minutes.

**Exit criteria:** Overlay + store + CLI work on all three OSes within the resource budget.

### E03 — Screen Capture

Per-OS capture adapters, frame ring buffer, dirty-rect re-analysis, protected content, DPI, permissions.

**Goals**

- 2 fps analysis and 15 fps tracking within budget on all three OSes.
- Graceful degradation on DRM, secure desktops, and denied permission.
- No frame leaves the process.

**Exit criteria:** Capture works on all three OSes; perf budgets met; no-network test passes.

### E04 — Accessibility Tree & Merge

macOS AX, Windows UIA, Linux AT-SPI, element model, provenance-aware merge, stability tracking.

**Goals**

- A merged ScreenGraph with per-property provenance.
- Stable element IDs across frames and scroll compensation.
- Read-only by default; write access is a separate capability.

**Exit criteria:** Merge matches >=95% of a11y elements to vision elements; differential test passes.

### E05 — Vision Perception

Detector, OCR, layout, icon captioning, motion/media, reading level, interruptions, ROI recapture, benchmarks.

**Goals**

- Detection mAP >= 0.80 (target 0.85) on the fixture set.
- OCR CER < 8% Latin, < 15% CJK at 1080p.
- Perception p95 < 250 ms at 1080p.

**Exit criteria:** Benchmarks met on all three OSes; no-network test passes.

### E06 — Understanding & Language

Rules engine, jargon, numbers, simplification, meaning preservation, summarization, chunking, icon semantics, sensitive-content guard, cache.

**Goals**

- Meaning-preservation score >= 4/5 on a 200-item human-rated set.
- Sensitive content (financial/medical/legal) always warns and shows the original.
- Everything works offline.

**Exit criteria:** Meaning score met; sensitive-content cases covered; cache eviction verified.

### E07 — Adaptation Engine

Profiles, rules engine, dimming, icon grid, reflow, ruler, stop-motion, inbox, one-step mode, confirm/undo, layout solver, plan cache, per-app memory, provenance.

**Goals**

- Four starter profiles produce human-rated >= 4/5 plans.
- Plan build p95 < 50 ms warm.
- No overlap or clipping under 10k fuzz cases.

**Exit criteria:** Profiles validated; solver fuzz clean; rationale available for every action.

### E08 — Overlay Rendering & Interaction

Design system, in-place renderer, simplified view, hit-testing, click-through, keyboard, switch access, large targets, animation policy, action consent, a11y audit.

**Goals**

- Input-to-visual p95 < 100 ms.
- 100% keyboard operability, no traps.
- Screen reader pass on VoiceOver, NVDA, Orca.

**Exit criteria:** A11y audit clean; 4-hour dogfood with zero crashes.

### E09 — Speech & Voice

TTS abstraction, hover-to-read, read selection, read-from-here, voice control, audio focus, settings, overlay TTS, offline fallback.

**Goals**

- Hover-to-speak p95 < 250 ms.
- Voice commands >= 95% in quiet, >= 85% noisy.
- No audio focus conflict with screen readers.

**Exit criteria:** Speech works offline; espeak fallback < 50 ms; highlight alignment within one word.

### E10 — Input & Navigation

Global shortcuts, hover tracking, click routing, keyboard model, switch access, voice grammar, large targets, focus handoff.

**Goals**

- Every overlay action reachable by keyboard and by voice.
- Focus handoff to the real app is explicit and reversible.
- Switch access works with a single button.

**Exit criteria:** Keyboard + voice + switch coverage matrix complete.

### E11 — Data & Personalization

Profile editor, learned simplifications, app layout memory, memory aids, backup/restore, optional sync, multi-user, import/export, local stats, telemetry schema.

**Goals**

- Backup/restore survives reinstall.
- Learned simplifications improve acceptance by >= 10%.
- Sync is E2E encrypted and off by default.

**Exit criteria:** Per-user stores isolated; sync shows no plaintext on the wire.

### E12 — Privacy & Security

Kill-switch, zeroization, no-content logging, encryption at rest, keychain, model pinning, penetration test, privacy audit, WCAG/COGA mapping, incident response, SBOM, license compliance.

**Goals**

- Zero content in logs, asserted on every PR.
- External penetration and privacy audits clean before 1.0.
- No critical or high CVEs; SBOM published per release.

**Exit criteria:** Audits clean or findings explicitly accepted with a date.

### E13 — Testing & Quality

Unit blitz, property tests, golden tests, differential tests, integration, E2E, perf, a11y audit, chaos, dogfood.

**Goals**

- >= 80% coverage on core crates; 100% on rules/merge/privacy guards.
- Perf budgets met on three reference machines.
- Dogfood: >= 70% would keep using it; all critical bugs fixed.

**Exit criteria:** Coverage, perf, and dogfood gates met.

### E14 — Release & Packaging

Installers, signing/notarization, updater with rollback, beta program, VPAT, pricing, support, 1.0.

**Goals**

- Clean-machine install and auto-update rollback on all three OSes.
- Advisory panel signs off on 1.0.
- Support load < 1 ticket per 100 users per week at launch.

**Exit criteria:** 1.0 signed, reproducible, updatable, and advisory-approved.

### E15 — Ecosystem & Growth

Browser extension, mobile companion, SDK, enterprise console, marketplace, open benchmark.

**Goals**

- A thin browser extension reuses the same profile engine.
- Enterprise console supports MDM and fleet profiles.
- The fixture dataset and benchmark are published.

**Exit criteria:** At least one ecosystem product ships and the benchmark is public.
